title: Heiligengeistfeld Flak Tower

terrainReference.basis: Original public terrain close to the northwest entrance forecourt.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap way 264581795, matched to the municipal heritage description and historic bunker photographs.
mapIdentity.scope: Named and mapped bunker at Feldstraße 66, original 2006 Qualla exterior, current outline used to trace the projecting parapet, and unmodified public elevation field.

note: Four full-height concrete bastions project around a recessed five-level body, beneath a continuous gun-platform canopy and four tall capped octagons. Existing post-war window cuts and entrances are modeled as seen in the 2006 photograph.
